title: Zesty Flaky Polish Pork Pierogi
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring mustardy pork filling wrapped in flaky dough, perfect for a brunch mood, this keto-friendly recipe is a delicious twist on a classic.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, mustard, sour cream, egg, salt, and pepper, and mix until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour and melted butter until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of the pork filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling, forming a half-circle shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pierogi for 5 minutes, until they float to the surface.
Remove the pierogi from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
